defs.def: having beauty; pleasing to the senses or to the mind 美丽的；美好的

ex.s: Ursula has always called the beautiful small town of Beaverton her home.
ex.t: 乌苏拉一直把美丽的小镇比弗顿称为她的家。

ex.s: Four years later, those beautiful 10 acres of fields had turned into 20 acres filled with over 400,000 sunflowers.
ex.t: 四年后，那片美丽的10英亩田地变成了20英亩，种满了超过40万株向日葵。

ex.s: Beautiful year-round, they invite you to enjoy the smallest detail, from the sound of grasses in the gentle wind to the sculpture of odd-looking seed heads.
ex.t: 良好的社会习惯在社会环境中发挥类似作用。

ex.s: This beautiful structure, named Glasshouse, is at the centre of a new garden that shows how the Silk Road influences English gardens even in modern times.
ex.t: 这座名为Glasshouse的美丽建筑位于一座新花园的中心，展示了丝绸之路如何在现代仍影响着英国花园。

ex.s: The latest ____56____ (engineer) techniques are applied to create this protective ____57____ (function) structure that is also beautiful.
ex.t: 最新的____（工程）技术被用于打造这一兼具保护____（功能）与美观的结构。

ex.s: What should ____45____(do) with such a beautiful place?
ex.t: 这样一个美丽的地方该___45___（做）什么？

ex.s: Cycling is the most economical, sustainable and fun way to explore the city, with its beautiful canals, parks, squares and countless lights.
ex.t: 骑自行车是最经济、可持续且有趣的城市探索方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: The menu in this beautiful colonial house includes traditional Thai cuisine combined with modern cooking methods.
ex.t: 这座美丽的殖民风格宅邸里的菜单包括传统泰国菜与现代烹饪方法的结合。

ex.s: The bees, butterfly and many other insects looked lovely and beautifully on the stamps.
ex.t: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶和许多其他昆虫在邮票上看起来可爱又美丽。

ex.s: I have missed plenty of beautiful sunsets/sunrises due to being on the spot only five minutes before the best moment.
ex.t: 由于只在最佳时刻前五分钟赶到现场，我错过了许多美丽的日落和日出。

ex.s: Not only do they look beautiful
ex.t: 它们不仅看起来漂亮

ex.s: Researchers use brain imaging technique to see which brain areas light up when we view paintings that we consider beautiful.
ex.t: 研究人员使用脑成像技术来观察当我们观看我们认为美丽的画作时，哪些大脑区域会被激活。

ex.s: But why do we find some art beautiful and other art ugly?
ex.t: 但为什么我们发现有些艺术美丽而另一些艺术丑陋呢？

ex.s: The part of the brain related to pleasure is activated in response to something we find beautiful.
ex.t: 与愉悦相关的大脑部分会对我们发现的美的事物作出反应而被激活。

ex.s: A beautiful painting or sculpture.
ex.t: 一幅美丽的画作或雕塑。

ex.s: I really want to go to a place for the summer vacation, ________ especially with beautiful scenery and unique culture.
ex.t: 我真的很想去一个地方度暑假，（第__空）特别是风景优美、文化独特的地方。

ex.s: On a beautiful Wednesday morning, I awoke in a shared room in the hospital.
ex.t: 一个美丽的周三早晨，我在医院的一间多人病房醒来。

ex.s: It offers beautiful furnishings and beds.
ex.t: 它提供精美的家具和床铺。

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: Journey through the beautiful countryside of Provence，France，with Prof Ori Z.
ex.t: 与Ori Z教授一起穿越法国普罗旺斯美丽的乡村。

ex.s: to form a beautiful sight of the city
ex.t: 以形成城市的一道美丽风景

ex.s: This small group bike tour is a fantastic way to see a world-famous cherry trees with beautiful flowers of Washington, D.C.
ex.t: 这次小团骑行之旅是欣赏华盛顿特区世界闻名的樱花树的绝佳方式。

ex.s: "That was my home． I was a teenager sitting in the hall． Before you came over， I never realized what a beautiful place I lived in． I never felt lucky before． You thought it was a museum． My feelings about my home changed after that． I've always wanted to thank you．"
ex.t: “那是我家。我当时是个坐在厅里的少年。你来之前，我从没意识到自己住的地方多美。我以前从没觉得自己幸运。你以为那是博物馆。从那以后我对家的感觉变了。我一直想谢谢你。”

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: However, when it works, it is simply beautiful.
ex.t: 我给了房主尽可能多的信息，然后回家看看夜晚会带来什么消息。

ex.s: He hoped to show them this beautiful place someday.
ex.t: 他希望有一天能向他们展示这个美丽的地方。

ex.s: Every year, ______ makes the most beautiful kite will win a prize in the Kite Festival.
ex.t: 每年，____做出最漂亮风筝的人将在风筝节上获奖。

ex.s: Every autumn, millions of these beautiful insects with fine black and orange wings begin a long and difficult journey.
ex.t: 每年秋天，数百万只这种带有纤细的黑色和橙色翅膀的美丽昆虫开始一段漫长而艰难的旅程。

ex.s: Not only do they provide us with food, clothes and oxygen to breathe, but they also make our surroundings more beautiful.
ex.t: 它们不仅为我们提供食物、衣物和呼吸所需的氧气，还使我们周围的环境更加美丽。

ex.s: I was focusing on taking photos of the beautiful view, but suddenly I felt that someone or something was watching me.
ex.t: 我正专注于拍摄美丽的风景，但突然我感觉有什么人或什么东西在看着我。

ex.s: Many people thought she didn’t live up to Helen’s title of “the most beautiful woman in the world”, influencing opinions of the movie to some extent.
ex.t: 很多人认为她配不上海伦"世界上最美丽的女人"的称号，这在一定程度上影响了人们对该电影的看法。

ex.s: It is extremely beautiful and you can experience the indigenous Australia there more than anywhere else.
ex.t: 那里极其美丽，你可以比在任何其他地方更能体验到原汁原味的澳大利亚。

defs.def: very good or skilful 很好的；出色的；巧妙的
